Source contracts: packaging/binary

packaging/binary/native-offline-linux.sh

Shell · Tier B

Bootstrap native Linux acceptance in a clean container without development tools.

Usage

Disposable native-distribution fixture with /release artifacts and /native_acceptance.py mounted.

Inputs

SHA256SUMS, compressed or standalone server binary, and distinct legal versions read from the binary.

Side effects

Verifies checksums, extracts a bootstrap copy, explicitly accepts both legal versions, installs the private runtime and writes runtime diagnostics.

Cleanup

Deletes the bootstrap binary before exec of native_acceptance.py; the temporary home and report storage are owned by the container.

@see scripts/native_acceptance.py

packaging/binary/offline-linux.sh

Shell · Tier B

Inspect legacy binary distributions through their extracted private interpreter.

Usage

Container-only acceptance with /release and /probe.py mounted.

Inputs

SHA256SUMS and server/agent archives or executable artifacts; SMTO_BINARY_INTERNAL_INSPECT selects runtime inspection.

Side effects

Creates a disposable home and instance root, extracts both roles and captures the server interpreter path.

Cleanup

exec transfers control to the private Python probe; /tmp installation/extraction state is removed when the container is discarded.

@see scripts/binary_container_probe.py
